title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode2 Graffiti Everywhere

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line: Let's see. Ms. Azusawa, would you solve this problem for us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, o-okay... Um, I...

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line: Not sure, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, you, uh...square the three and...

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line: How about you, Ms. Sato?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was rude. They could have given you a little more time!
You knew the answer, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
But it's okay. It's my fault for not speaking up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even though I'm in high school now, I haven't changed a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time! I've got to get to dance practice!
See you tomorrow, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. See you tomorrow, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Minori sure is amazing.
She's working so hard to achieve her dream of becoming an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't remember it very well, but that dream I had the other day gave me the feeling something was about to change.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if I'd be able to change if I found a dream or a goal to reach for like Minori.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Mom's texting me. Hm?
<Could you buy that CD for me on your way home?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
She must be talking about that new album she mentioned the other day.
<Okay, will do.>
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I was in a CD shop.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, they're playing that new Miku single.
It sounds so cool. I wonder who wrote it.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm? It should be around here somewhere.
Excuse me, do you have this CD?

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Oh, I'm very sorry, but we're currently sold out of that particular album. Our alley shop still has a few copies, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The alley shop? Isn't that the one in that scary-looking back alley?)

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: If you'd like, I can call and have them reserve a copy for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'd rather not go down that street, but Mom was really looking forward to this.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you. I'll head over there now.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Come again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad I found a copy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This area really does have a spooky feel to it, though. Why are all the walls covered in graffiti?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The map on my phone says the station is back this way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Huh? This street doesn't look familiar.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Where am I?
Oh no! My phone just died!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It won't turn back on! What am I going to do...
I-I'll have to ask someone for directions...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Ahahahaha! What are you talking about?!
You're so full of yourself!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um, excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hey, what do you say we stay out all night?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Wh-What should I do...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't recognize this street either.
A-And it's starting to get dark...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Why am I always like this? I don't even have the courage to ask someone for directions...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't deal with something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? Is that...music?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's coming from over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Weekend Garage?
It says they're open. I wonder what kind of place it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, maybe someone who works there can give me directions. But that would mean going into a shop I've never been to before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
At this rate, though, it's going to get dark soon.
I-I'll have to try it...
Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

Yeah, that's great!
You guys sound even better than usual!

rows.Speaker: DJ
rows.Line: That's because you're here to help, An! Are you sure you don't want to team up with us and put on some shows?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm... I'll think about it.

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: Hahaha! Rejected again! All right, now that we're warmed up, let's move on to the next set. Since there's three of us, how about a mic relay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it! I'm going to freestyle a little, then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um, excuse me...
song00001_on_s

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's...this...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (My ears feel like they're ringing, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Amazing... They're so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, that was great! Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line:
Man, you're starting to make us look bad.
You've been practicing again, haven't you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, but I still have a long way to go.
I want to become even better than I am now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then I'm going to put on a show that'll be even greater than RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: DJ
rows.Line: Better than that?! Dreamin' big again, I see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It sounds like she has some kind of dream.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I bet that's why she looks so cool while she's singing.)

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: I bet you feel pretty proud to have a daughter who wants to follow in your footsteps, don't you Ken?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure do. It's a bit strange, though. I didn't teach her a thing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't very well sit around twiddling my thumbs after seeing a show like yours, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just you wait! I swear I'll surpass you one of these days!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to it. Before you go showing up your old man, though, how about you take that table their order?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm on it! You might try to treat your employees a bit nicer, though. Oh? A customer?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry about that. I was so absorbed with my singing that I didn't see you there! Here, this seat over here is open.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Ah... I-I, uh... Um...
I-I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, wait!
She left...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I feel like I've seen her before, though.
Maybe at a show somewhere?

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I ran away... And after she was nice enough to talk to me, too...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... What's going on? What is this feeling?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My heart is racing!
